rows.statement: 上一集读的是对待错误的原则;最后一集。
rows.source_locator: series-manifest.json units pr (04 把错误摆上桌面) and lt (05, last); episodes/04-principles/script.json pr.b24 ('一套对待错误的办法')
rows.note: Series-internal structure claim, matches the manifest.

rows.statement: 入职的包裹里,为什么有一本写九一一的书(公司给新人寄这本书)。
rows.source_locator: Qureshi, Reflections on Palantir, local snapshot qureshi-reflections-on-palantir.html.txt line 161: 'I'm not sure if they still do this, but at the time when you joined they sent you a copy of … The Looming Tower (9/11 book)…'
rows.note: '包裹' is not in the source (he says 'sent you a copy'). The unqualified present-tense frame drops his time anchor ('at the time when you joined', 2015 per pr.b2) and his explicit 'I'm not sure if they still do this'. Nothing in the lt episode restores either, so a viewer who sees only this episode gets a standing practice from one witness's memory of his own hiring.

rows.statement: The Looming Tower 是记者 Lawrence Wright 二〇〇六年出的书,写九一一之前的那些年。
rows.source_locator: Open Library record ISBN 9780375414862 (Knopf, 8 Aug 2006, subtitle 'Al-Qaeda and the Road to 9/11'); NPR 2007-04-17 page ('Lawrence Wright, staff writer for The New Yorker')
rows.note: Fine as a statement about the 2006 first edition. Which edition new hires received is unsourced, and the script does not claim one.

rows.statement: Qureshi 说,发这本书的理由很明显。
rows.source_locator: Qureshi snapshot line 161: 'The Looming Tower was obvious enough'
rows.note: 'obvious enough' is slightly weaker than '很明显'; immaterial.

rows.statement: 公司创立,一部分就是在回应九一一,以及随之而来的公民自由问题。
rows.source_locator: Qureshi snapshot line 161: 'the company was founded partly as a response to 9/11 and what Peter felt were the inevitable violations of civil liberties that would follow'
rows.note: Drops the attribution 'what Peter felt' (the civil-liberties worry is Thiel's, relayed by Qureshi) and softens 'inevitable violations' to '问题'. The script reads as Qureshi asserting the company's founding rationale himself.

rows.statement: 这段背景有用。
rows.source_locator: Qureshi snapshot line 161: 'the context was valuable'

rows.statement: Palantir 二〇二〇年上市前提交的文件里写着公司成立于九一一袭击之后,起初是给美国情报界的反恐调查和行动做软件。
rows.source_locator: Palantir Form S-1 filed 2020-08-25 (scratch palantir-s1.txt): Key Factors/Crisis ('Our company was founded in the wake of the attacks on September 11th'); Business > Overview ('We were founded in 2003 and started building software for the intelligence community in the United States to assist in counterterrorism investigations and operations')
rows.note: Company self-description in a registration statement; the script does not overstate it.

rows.statement: 这本书的正文,我能合法读到的,只有开篇的一段节选。
rows.source_locator: vault/snapshots/local/palantir-20261006/wright-looming-tower-publisher-page.html.txt line 1100 ('The Martyr', about 2,470 words, Vintage 2007 paperback page); Open Library record has ocaid 'loomingtoweralqa00wrig'; institutional-failure/log.md ('no Internet Archive lending')
rows.note: True of the free text the production used. 'Legally readable' is wrong as a general statement: the book can be bought or borrowed (the Open Library record points to an Internet Archive lending copy, which the research deliberately did not use). Accurate wording: the only text freely posted that I read.

rows.statement: 这段节选写一个埃及人一九四八年坐船去美国,跟机构之间的事无关。
rows.source_locator: Publisher excerpt, line 1100: Sayyid Qutb on a cruise ship from Alexandria to New York, 'November 1948'; keyword count in the excerpt for CIA, FBI, intelligence, agency, agencies, 9/11, September 11, Al Qaeda: 0
rows.note: The excerpt goes on to Qutb's views of American society, so 'writes a sea voyage' under-describes it. The no-agencies claim holds.

rows.statement: 下面用的,是 Wright 自己在《纽约客》上发表的报道和他的访谈,加上美国九一一委员会的官方报告。
rows.source_locator: Script body: b13 (CIA OIG Executive Summary, June 2005, pp. xv-xvi), b14 (Soufan at the 9/11 Memorial panel, 2018-03-13, 00:59:13 and 01:00:00), b1/b21 (Qureshi), b2 (S-1)
rows.note: The source roll-call is wrong in both directions. The CIA Inspector General report and Soufan's panel remarks are used but not named; Soufan is not Wright. No sentence in the script is traceable to a Wright interview. The New Yorker article (The Agent) and the Commission report are the only two named sources actually used for the story.

rows.statement: 书里具体怎么写,我没法核对。
rows.source_locator: Research log finding 2; claim lt.unres-book-text (Salon 2006-08-30 quotes the book with wording different from The Agent)
rows.note: Accurate limit, and it matters: the book and the article are not interchangeable.

rows.statement: 照 Wright 的报道,一九九九年底,CIA 从一通电话里得知,基地组织的人要在马来西亚聚会,其中一个叫 Khalid al-Mihdhar。
rows.source_locator: Wright, The Agent (New Yorker, 2006), para 37: 'A conversation on the Hada phone at the end of 1999 mentioned a forthcoming meeting of Al Qaeda operatives in Malaysia. The C.I.A. learned the name of one participant, Khaled al-Mihdhar'; cf. 9/11 Commission Report p.181
rows.note: Properly attributed to Wright. Spelling differs (Khaled vs Khalid); trivial.

rows.statement: CIA 进了他在迪拜住的酒店房间,复印了他的护照,护照里有一个美国签证。
rows.source_locator: The Agent para 38: 'broke into a hotel room in Dubai where Mihdhar was staying… photocopied Mihdhar's passport… Inside the passport was the critical information that Mihdhar had a U.S. visa'; Commission ch.6 endnote 44, p.502 (passport photocopied and forwarded to CIA HQ)
rows.note: The break-in appears only in Wright; the Commission note confirms the copied passport with a US visa. The script's 'per Wright' attribution is right. '进了' softens 'broke into'.

rows.statement: 委员会的报告写道,二〇〇〇年一月,CIA 知道了 Mihdhar 有美国签证。
rows.source_locator: 9/11 Commission Report p.182 ('in January, when word arrived of Mihdhar's visa'); p.355 box item 1

rows.statement: 三月,又得知他的同伴 Nawaf al-Hazmi 一月十五日飞到了洛杉矶。
rows.source_locator: Commission Report p.181 ('In early March 2000, Bangkok reported that Nawaf al Hazmi… had departed on January 15 on a United Airlines flight to Los Angeles'); p.354

rows.statement: 这些消息,都没有送到 FBI。
rows.source_locator: Commission Report p.182: 'None of this information—about Mihdhar's U.S. visa or Hazmi's travel to the United States—went to the FBI'
rows.note: Commission wording. The CIA IG (p.xv) says it could not confirm whether the Jan 5 2000 message was passed or not, so this is the Commission's finding, as the script says.

rows.statement: 两个人也都没有被放进国务院的观察名单。
rows.source_locator: Commission Report p.181-182 ('The CIA did not try to register Mihdhar or Hazmi with the State Department's TIPOFF watchlist—either in January… or in March'); p.270 (both added to the watchlist on August 24, 2001)
rows.note: Correct for 2000, but the sentence carries no date. Both were added to TIPOFF on 24 Aug 2001, so 'never' would be wrong; a viewer could hear it that way.

rows.statement: 二〇〇一年六月十一日,CIA 和 FBI 的人在纽约开会,会上拿出了那次聚会的照片。
rows.source_locator: Commission Report pp.268-269 ('Jane brought the surveillance pictures'; 'Jane, Dave, and an FBI analyst… went to New York on June 11')

rows.statement: CIA 的分析员知道签证,也知道洛杉矶,可是没人问他,他也没有说。
rows.source_locator: Commission Report p.269: 'Dave… knew that Mihdhar possessed a U.S. visa… that Hazmi had traveled to Los Angeles… No one at the meeting asked him what he knew; he did not volunteer anything'
rows.note: Commission account (pseudonym 'Dave'). Wright's account of the same meeting differs (CIA supervisor Clark Shannon refuses to answer); see next row.

rows.statement: FBI 的探员要他们的出生日期和护照号,没有拿到。
rows.source_locator: Wright, The Agent para 56 ('Steve Bongardt… asked Shannon to provide a date of birth or a passport number to go with Mihdhar's name… Shannon declined'); Commission Report pp.268-269 contain no such request (the agents asked only why the photos were taken, why the people were followed, where the rest of the photographs were)
rows.note: Misattributed and blended. The detail is Wright's only, but it follows a Commission-sourced clause with no change of attribution. Wright's version names a CIA supervisor who refused; the Commission's names an analyst nobody asked, so the two halves of the sentence come from accounts that conflict (research log finding 3). '他们的' (both men) also widens Wright's 'Mihdhar's name'.

rows.statement: 到了八月,FBI 终于开始找这两个人。
rows.source_locator: Commission Report p.270 (Aug 21-24: INS check, watchlist, search begun; lead sent Aug 28 as 'Routine'); heading p.269 'The Search for Mihdhar and Hazmi Begins and Fails'
rows.note: '终于' is the narrator's gloss.

rows.statement: 一位分析员在邮件里说,因为那道墙,刑事侦查的人不能参与。
rows.source_locator: The Agent para 69 (Corsi's e-mail: 'because of the Wall no criminal investigators could be involved in the search'); Commission Report p.271 ('Jane argued… the wall kept him from participating'; she e-mailed the NSLU opinion)
rows.note: Faithful as what the analyst said. The Commission (p.271) adds that she 'appears to have misunderstood the complex rules' and that the criminal agent could have searched; the script gives the misunderstanding only in general form later (b12).

rows.statement: 负责 Cole 号案子的一名探员回信,说总有一天会有人死,到那时,不管有没有墙,公众都不会明白,为什么没有把所有的力量都用上。
rows.source_locator: Commission Report p.271: 'someday someone will die—and wall or not—the public will not understand why we were not more effective and throwing every resource we had at certain "problems"'
rows.note: The paraphrase drops 'more effective'; the meaning is intact.

rows.statement: 九月十一日早上,Mihdhar 和 Hazmi 在华盛顿的机场,登上了美国航空七十七号航班。
rows.source_locator: Commission Report pp.2-4 (Dulles International, 'in the Virginia suburbs of Washington, D.C.'; Mihdhar and Moqed boarded at 7:50; the Hazmi brothers joined Hanjour in first class)
rows.note: '华盛顿的机场' is loose: the airport is Dulles, in Virginia. 'Hazmi' means Nawaf; his brother Salem also boarded.

rows.statement: 消息为什么没送到,几方的解释并不一样。
rows.source_locator: Research log finding 4: Wright (mission and animus), Commission (no owner, incentives), CIA IG ('do not lie in reluctance to share'), Soufan ('wasn't institutional')
rows.note: Fair framing.

rows.statement: Wright 的解释先是使命不同:FBI 收集情报是为了把人送上法庭定罪;CIA 把情报本身当作目标;两家长年争地盘。
rows.source_locator: The Agent para 33: 'The F.B.I. and the C.I.A. have long quarrelled over bureaucratic turf, and their mandates place them at odds. The ultimate goal of the bureau in gathering intelligence is to gain convictions for crimes; for the agency, intelligence itself is the object.'
rows.note: Close paraphrase.

rows.statement: 他也写到了个人之间的恩怨(并以使命与恩怨作为'Wright 的解释')。
rows.source_locator: The Agent para 42 (animosity is the claim of 'several of O'Neill's subordinates'; Scheuer calls O'Neill 'duplicitous'); para 43 (CIA may also have been protecting an overseas operation or hoping to recruit Mihdhar and Hazmi); para 44 ('may be best explained by the fact that the agency was drowning in a flood of threats and warnings'; Wright adds 'Whatever the reason')
rows.note: Not false, but selective. Wright lists several hedged possibilities and the one he calls the best explanation is overload, which is not in the script. That omission makes Wright look opposed to the CIA IG (workload/process) when his own best guess is nearer to it. The animosity is reported from FBI sources, not asserted by Wright in the article.

rows.statement: 一九九五年司法部定下的一套共享程序,很快被误解、被误用,后来被叫作墙。
rows.source_locator: Commission Report p.79: 'In July 1995, Attorney General Reno issued formal procedures… almost immediately misunderstood and misapplied… Over time the procedures came to be referred to as "the wall."'

rows.statement: 委员会说这个词有误导性,实际上是一层叠一层的障碍,连同一个小组里的探员都被隔开。
rows.source_locator: Commission Report p.79: 'The term "the wall" is misleading… a series of barriers'; 'pressure from the Office of Intelligence Policy Review, FBI leadership, and the FISA Court built barriers between agents—even agents serving on the same squads'
rows.note: The 1995 procedures themselves covered only agent-to-prosecutor sharing; the same-squad barrier came from later pressure. The script's wording is compatible.

rows.statement: FBI 的副局长还提醒过探员,信息共享得太多,可能断送前程。
rows.source_locator: Commission Report p.79: 'FBI Deputy Director Bryant reinforced the Office's caution by informing agents that too much information sharing could be a career stopper'

rows.statement: CIA 自己的监察长说,这件事里系统性的失败,不在于不愿意共享,而在于本来用来交换信息的那些流程,执行得很差。
rows.source_locator: CIA OIG Report on CIA Accountability… Executive Summary (June 2005), p.xvi, 'Broader Information Sharing Issues': 'the systemic failures in this case do not lie in reluctance to share. Rather, the basic problems were poor implementation, guidance, and oversight of processes established to foster the exchange of information'
rows.note: The paraphrase drops 'guidance and oversight'. The same summary (p.xv) still says CIA officers 'failed to pass the travel information… to the FBI' and recommends accountability reviews, so 'not reluctance' is about the systemic cause, not a clearing of individuals.

rows.statement: 有一条该发给 FBI 的消息,看样子是因为格式不对、还要再改,一直没有发出去。
rows.source_locator: CIA OIG Executive Summary p.xv: 'Apparently because it was in the wrong format or needed editing, the message was never sent'; cf. Commission ch.6 endnote 44, p.502
rows.note: The IG's hedge ('Apparently') is kept as '看样子'. The script leaves out that Commission endnote 44 gives a different cause for what appears to be the same Jan 2000 message (a CIA desk officer told the FBI detailee not to send the cable). That is a direct conflict between two official records.

rows.statement: Ali Soufan 是当年在 FBI 追查这条线的探员。
rows.source_locator: The Agent paras 33-34 and 56 (Soufan's formal requests to the CIA); 9/11 Memorial panel 2018-03-13 transcript 00:58:03

rows.statement: 多年后在一次对谈里说,这不是机构的问题,是个别人决定不分享,他到现在也不知道为什么。
rows.source_locator: 9/11 Memorial and Museum panel 'The Looming Tower', 2018-03-13, transcript 00:59:13 ('I think it wasn't institutional. I truly believe that… based on individuals… I still don't know why') and 01:00:00
rows.note: Audience Q&A at a panel about the Hulu series, not an interview. Soufan frames it as belief ('I think'), and says he has private assumptions he will not state.

rows.statement: 这几种说法,各有各的根据,也互相冲突。
rows.source_locator: Soufan 00:59:13 versus CIA OIG p.xvi; Wright (mission) versus Commission p.79 ('the wall' as misapplied procedure)
rows.note: Narrator's evaluation, unmarked but uncontroversial.

rows.statement: 委员会自己提醒过:观察名单、信息共享、连点成线这些说法,描述的都是症状,不是病根。
rows.source_locator: Commission Report p.400: 'watchlisting… information sharing… connecting the dots. In chapter 11 we explained that these labels are too narrow. They describe the symptoms, not the disease.'

rows.statement: 委员会说的病根,是没有人真正管着整个案子:没有一个人能从政府的任何地方调来相关的情报,跨机构分派责任,盯着进展,遇到障碍就提到能解决它的那一级。
rows.source_locator: Commission Report p.400: 'In each of our examples, no one was firmly in charge of managing the case and able to draw relevant intelligence from anywhere in the government, assign responsibilities across the agencies (foreign or domestic), track progress, and quickly bring obstacles up to the level where they could be resolved.'
rows.note: The content matches word for word. The Commission never writes 'the disease is X' in one sentence; the identification rests on adjacency here and on p.353 ('symptoms of the government's broader inability to adapt how it manages problems'). A fair reading, presented as the Commission's own.

rows.statement: 它用了一个比喻:各个机构像一群专科医生,各自开检查、看症状、开药,缺的是一位主治医生,确保大家作为一个团队来工作。
rows.source_locator: Commission Report p.353 (11.4 Management): 'The agencies are like a set of specialists in a hospital, each ordering tests, looking for symptoms, and prescribing medications. What is missing is the attending physician who makes sure they work as a team.'
rows.note: The metaphor is in ch.11, not ch.13; the script does not say otherwise.

rows.statement: 报告也写明了另一面:就算八月下旬就开始找,要在九一一之前找到这两个人,也既要技巧,也要运气。
rows.source_locator: Commission Report p.272: 'the investigators would have needed luck as well as skill to find them prior to September 11 even if such searches had begun as early as August 23'
rows.note: The same paragraph also says that with more resources and a different approach the two 'might have been found', and that they could have been detained. The script gives only the cautionary half.

rows.statement: 在讲信息共享的那一节,委员会把这些故事归到一处:一套要先证明需要知道、才肯共享的制度。
rows.source_locator: Commission Report p.417 (13.3): 'What all these stories have in common is a system that requires a demonstrated "need to know" before sharing.'
rows.note: The report's 'these stories' are the three cases listed just before it (NSA data nobody asked for, material in a compartmented channel, information requested but not shareable). They overlap the Mihdhar episodes but are not literally every episode the script told; the CIA's non-notification in Jan and Mar 2000 is not one of the three.

rows.statement: 各机构的激励都反对共享,共享要冒风险,几乎没有回报,不共享却不受罚。
rows.source_locator: Commission Report p.417: 'Each agency's incentive structure opposes sharing, with risks (criminal, civil, and internal administrative sanctions) but few rewards… There are no punishments for not sharing information.'

rows.statement: 它提出的设计是:报告一生成,就把数据和情报的来源、手段分开,先发最能共享的版本;谁需要更多细节,再去查询,由规则决定给不给,每次查询都留下记录;权限管在数据这一层,而不是整个网络。
rows.source_locator: Commission Report pp.417-418: 'We therefore propose that when a report is first created, its data be separated from the sources and methods… begin with the information in its most shareable… any user can query further, with access granted or denied according to the rules set for the network—and with queries leaving an audit trail'; p.418 'information rights management… controls access to the data, not access to the whole network'
rows.note: The 'rights management' sentence sits in the Commission's description of the decentralized network model, whose framework it credits to the Markle Foundation task force. 'Meaningful' is dropped from 'most shareable, but still meaningful'. Neither is a material shift.

rows.statement: Qureshi 讲 Palantir 早年想通的一件事:客户那边争数据,一部分出于真实的安全顾虑。
rows.source_locator: Qureshi snapshot line 156: 'The other "secret" Palantir figured out early is that data access tussles were partly about genuine data security concerns'

rows.statement: 所以他们在数据整合的每一层都做了控制,按角色给权限,按行设规则,打上安全标记,留下审计记录。

rows.note: '所以' is slightly stronger than Qureshi's 'could be alleviated through'. This is his own self-description and was not checked against Palantir documentation.

rows.statement: (Qureshi 的说法)用的是很相近的词。
rows.source_locator: Qureshi snapshot line 156 versus Commission Report pp.417-418
rows.note: The overlap is narrow: access governed at the data level, and an audit trail. Qureshi's role-based, row-level and marking controls are not in the Commission; the Commission's separation of data from sources and methods, shareable-first versions and query-on-demand are not in Qureshi. The sentence states the similarity as fact before b22 labels it 'my comparison'. 'Partly parallel' would be accurate.

rows.statement: 把这两段文字放在一起,是我的对照。
rows.source_locator: Script self-label; claim lt.inf-parallel notes this is an inference to be flagged on screen
rows.note: This is the explicit narrator-reading label for the b20-b21 juxtaposition.

rows.statement: 没有一手材料说 Palantir 的设计来自委员会的报告,也没有材料说公司发这本书,是为了信息共享的教训。

rows.statement: 我的读法是,这本书给新人的,是一个具体的提醒:在大组织里,最要紧的信息,常常就在某个人手里,没有送到最需要它的人那里。

rows.statement: FDE 每天要做的,正是把这些信息接起来,同时管好谁能看到什么。
rows.source_locator: Qureshi snapshot lines 150-156 ('Another key thing FDEs did was data integration… security controls into the data integration layer')
rows.note: '每天' and '正是' say more than 'another key thing FDEs did'. The sentence is also indicative and sits outside the '我的读法是' clause, so it reads as a fact about the job rather than part of the marked reading.

summary:
I found no statement that is plainly false (no 'wrong' verdicts) and none with no source at all. Nine statements overreach. Most of the script follows the sources closely, including the Commission pages (pp.2-4, 79, 181-182, 267-272, 353, 400, 417-418), the CIA Inspector General executive summary (pp.xv-xvi), Wright's The Agent, Qureshi's essay, the S-1 and Soufan's panel remarks.

The overreaches, most serious first:

1. **lt.b7, misattribution.** The request for birth dates and passport numbers is only in Wright's The Agent (para 56). The Commission report has nothing like it. It is placed straight after Commission-sourced clauses, and the two accounts of the June 11 meeting conflict: Wright has a CIA supervisor refusing, the Commission has an analyst nobody asked.
2. **lt.b3, wrong source list.** The script says it uses Wright's articles and interviews plus the Commission. It also uses the CIA Inspector General report (b13) and Soufan's 2018 panel remarks (b14), and no line traces to a Wright interview.
3. **lt.b3, 合法.** 'Legally readable' is wrong as a general statement. The book can be bought or borrowed, and an Internet Archive lending copy exists. The narrator means the free text they read.
4. **lt.i1 and lt.b1.** The hedges are dropped from Qureshi's account: 'at the time when you joined', 'I'm not sure if they still do this', and 'what Peter felt' about the civil-liberties worry. '包裹' is the script's own word.
5. **lt.b11, selective.** Wright offers several hedged explanations and calls overload the best one. The script shows only mission and grudges, which makes Wright look opposed to the CIA Inspector General when his own best guess is closer to it.
6. **lt.b21 and lt.b23.** 'Very similar words' overstates a narrow overlap (data-level access and an audit trail). The 'FDE every day' sentence overstates Qureshi's 'another key thing FDEs did'.
7. **lt.o1.** The end card lists source titles for claims shown on screen, not the original texts. The episode has no scenes yet, so it cannot be checked.

Three omissions are worth fixing even though the statements stand:
- Commission endnote 44 (p.502) gives a different reason from the Inspector General's 'wrong format' for the unsent January 2000 message. A CIA desk officer told the FBI detailee not to send it.
- b6 has no date. Both men were added to the watchlist on 24 August 2001.
